title: Phyll project configuration
description: Optional settings in .phyll/config.json at the root of the reviewed project. Every field is optional.

language.description: Language for the report. Defaults to the language of the product's interface.

entryUrl.description: Where the running app can be opened, such as http://localhost:3000.

startCommand.description: Command that starts the app, such as npm run dev.

endUser.description: Who uses the product, in one sentence.

coreJobs.description: The two or three things the end user comes to do.

ignore.description: Globs, relative to the project root, that the static scan skips.

telemetry.description: Opt in to sending anonymous numbers (tool version, mode, index, counts) to cloud.apiUrl. Off by default, and nothing is sent without a URL.

cloud.description: Phyll Cloud settings. The service does not exist yet; with both fields empty nothing leaves the machine. PHYLL_API_URL and PHYLL_API_KEY override these values.
